title: Onboard lyra-mini-3b v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
body: This PR adds onboarding artifacts for lyra-mini-3b v1.0. Motivation: provide a compact, low-cost 3B variant in the registry with validated performance profiles and automated changelog entries so downstream consumers (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) can rely on consistent metadata and release notes. Changes include: 1) model metadata and manifest (architecture, tokenizer, checksums, recommended quantization profiles, license) 2) performance profiles for common latency/throughput targets (seq=32/128/512, batch=1/8/32) including p95 latency and effective tokens/sec on A100 and T4 profiles 3) integration into the changelog automation pipeline so the model is included in generated release notes when promoted 4) docs page and quickstart example snippets 5) CI checks and unit tests for metadata schema validation. Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema validated - [x] Perf profiles generated and sanity-checked against benchmark lab - [x] Changelog automation config updated - [x] Docs added and linked - [x] CI green (after flake rerun) Notes: Performance profiles were produced from perf-canary runs and synthetic LTP workloads; numbers are conservative (tested across 3 runs) and include warmup. We recommend the default profile 'balanced' for Hosted; customers can pin low-latency or high-throughput variants. This PR intentionally marks recommended quantization as 4-bit for T4-class hardware and 8-bit for A100 to preserve quality; see metadata field "recommended_quant" for details. Follow-ups: add eval harness entries for lyra-mini to track quality regressions across rollouts (tracked in ENG-5699).
commits: Add lyra-mini-3b v1.0 metadata and manifest
Generate performance profiles (seq32/128/512, batch 1/8/32) from perf-canary runs
Wire lyra-mini into changelog automation and update templates
Add docs/quickstart and unit tests for metadata schema
review_comments: Liam: Looks good overall — can we add a brief note about expected quality delta vs lyra-7b in the docs?
Sofia: Please include license spdx identifier in metadata and confirm tokenizer provenance (SentencePiece v0.1.95).
Ethan: Perf numbers look sane; one flaky assertion in test_metadata_schema.py failed in CI. Recommend making timeout/backoff more lenient.
Author (Priya): Addressed Liam and Sofia in latest commit, added license=MIT and tokenizer details; fixed flaky assertion by increasing retry window and added comment explaining nondeterminism.
release_notes: - Onboarded lyra-mini-3b v1.0: compact 3B model optimized for latency-sensitive workloads. Includes validated performance profiles for A100 and T4, recommended quantization guidance, and documentation/quickstart. Changelog automation updated so this model will appear in generated release notes on promotion.
